title: TemporaryCastration
description: Limit lags caused by massive farms !
body:
**TemporaryCastration is a very simple plugin that allows Minecraft server administrators to limit massive farms entities.**

You define in the configuration file the raius around the player for which the limit is applied. You also set your maximum number of entities within this radius.

## Actions blocked :
- Feeding animals
- Creating Iron & Snow Golems
- Throwing chicken eggs and spawn eggs
_- Note : the plugin takes into account all the entities of the area (even hostile mobs)
_
## Installation :
- Download the plugin
- Drop it into your "plugins" folder of your server
- Restart the server
- Make sure that the activation message appears in console and that configuration is generated properly.


<details>
<summary>Configuration</summary>

```
settings:
  radius: 50
  entity-limit: 20

messages:
  action-cancelled: "§cAction annulée : trop d'entités dans la zone."
  item-refunded: "§aItem remboursé."
  reload-success: "§aConfiguration rechargée avec succès."
  no-permission: "§cVous n'avez pas la permission pour faire cela."
```

</details>


## Commands & Permissions :
- /tcreload - reload configuration
